description: Gevoelige bestemmingen PM 2,5 wegverkeer is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De belasting met PM2,5 (Jaargemiddelde PM2,5-concentratie in microgram/m3) als gevolg van wegen is vertaald naar GES (gezondheidseffectscreening)-contouren. Alle gevoelige bestemmingen in de verschillende GES-contouren gelegen zijn in beeld gebracht. Doel is inzicht in knelpunten in de bestaande situatie en in de aanwezige risico’s bij nieuwe ontwikkelingen. Met dit inzicht kunnen keuzes onderbouwd worden. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are adressen, luchtkwaliteit, milieu, milieukwaliteit, stikstof. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
